name: Odysseus
title: Trojan Tactician
summary: Seasoned General who will unlock vulnerabilities in your foes.
lore: Trickster, wanderer, and monster-slayer, Odysseus is the cleverest of Olympus’s many heroes. Able to see where even gods are blinded by their flaws, he has taken it upon himself to establish alliances on his realm’s behalf. He currently wanders Tian, strategically aiding against monsters and threats, hoping to attract positive attention from the celestial bureaucracy as the first steps toward negotiation.
archetype_description: Ignore 1% of enemy resistance for each piece of nightweave armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: If the target’s Turn Meter is above 50%, [Confuse] cannot be blocked and has a 25% increased chance.
Enemies also have their Divinity decreased by 10% when they take their turn.

skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 350%ATK with a 50% chance to place [ACC Down II] on the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Turn the Tide
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 500%ATK. If the target’s Turn Meter is above 50%, set the target’s Turn Meter to 50%. If the target’s Turn Meter is below 50%, has an 80% chance to place [SPD Down II] on the target in 2 turns.
